trigger.reason: PUB-P2E03's immutable 162-case Reference calibration matrix was blocked because 115 cases failed hard Reference validity. P2E04-P2E07 established that the dominant failures are strict local-balance retries whose rate scale worsens as dt decreases, that increasing max_iterations does not resolve them, and that for 102/103 diagnosed LOCAL_BAL states the configured 1e-12 cm/day criterion is not numerically distinguishable from the preregistered representation-floor estimate. A replacement calibration dataset must therefore be constructed as a new Reference-only domain rather than by removing or relabeling P2E03 failures.

scientific_question: Can one common temporal coarse/refined schedule be selected prospectively, using Reference-only validity across all 54 physical E0 combinations, such that the full six-material x three-Se x three-forcing domain yields a complete Reference self-disagreement dataset without changing Reference tolerances or excluding physical cases?

stage_A_common_temporal_domain_selection.refined_rule: For each candidate coarse dt, compare one Reference solve over dt with two sequential Reference solves over dt/2 + dt/2 from the same initial physical state and forcing.
stage_A_common_temporal_domain_selection.execution_rule: Execute every one of the 54 physical combinations at every preregistered temporal level before selecting a level. Do not stop after the first feasible level.
per_trajectory_validity: coarse, half1 and half2 all return SW_SOLVE_CONVERGED on route legacy-reference-bound
typed integrated_mass_balance_residual_cm is available and finite for all three solves
typed native_balance_rate_residual_cm_per_day is available and finite for all three solves
absolute typed integrated mass residual is <= 1e-12 cm for each solve
all endpoint pressure-head and water-content values are finite and remain inside the declared E0 physical state domain
coarse and refined endpoint shapes are identical and represent the same final physical time
stage_A_common_temporal_domain_selection.selection_rule: Select the smallest candidate coarse dt for which all 54 physical combinations satisfy every trajectory-validity rule. Selection is global: no material-, Se- or forcing-specific dt is permitted.
stage_A_common_temporal_domain_selection.failure_rule: If no candidate coarse dt gives 54/54 valid physical combinations, P2E08 is BLOCKED_REFERENCE_COMMON_DOMAIN and no calibration dataset or threshold rule may be derived.

stage_B_reference_self_disagreement_data.admission_condition: Stage A selected exactly one common coarse dt with 54/54 validity.
stage_B_reference_self_disagreement_data.dataset: The 54 coarse-versus-two-half Reference pairs at the selected common dt; no physical case may be removed.
diagnostics: typed integrated mass residual for coarse, half1 and half2
typed native balance-rate residual for coarse, half1 and half2
material, Se, forcing, selected coarse dt and half dt
allowed_aggregation: minimum, maximum, median and fixed quantiles over all 54 cases
descriptive stratification by the already-preregistered material, Se and forcing axes
forbidden_interpretation: do not freeze a RossFast admissibility threshold in P2E08
do not choose a multiplicative safety factor in P2E08
do not inspect RossFast discrepancies before a later threshold workunit is preregistered
do not claim that the selected dt is an optimal or universal Reference timestep

relation_to_p2e07.use_of_p2e07: P2E07 motivates moving to a prospectively selected common temporal domain and forbids treating the strict small-dt failure surface as a valid calibration discriminator.
relation_to_p2e07.nonuse_of_p2e07: The P2E07 estimated floor is not promoted to a production convergence tolerance or a universal hard gate in P2E08.

required: exact execution of 54 physical combinations at all five temporal candidates
deterministic global selection rule applied only after full Reference-only execution
full relevant canonical preservation gates on the resulting PR
qualification.scientific_outcome_is_not_a_pass_conditi: A blocked common temporal domain remains valid evidence and must not be repaired by removing cases or widening tolerances.

expected_followup_if_qualified: A separate preregistered workunit may use the complete P2E08 Reference-only dataset to freeze the scientific state/storage tolerance formula, independent application-resolution floors, safety factor and any permitted predeclared stratification before new RossFast matrix results are inspected.
next_permitted_action: Implement only the Reference-only P2E08 domain-selection and self-disagreement harness plus CI wrapper. Do not compile or execute the RossFast numerical solver and do not freeze any scientific admissibility threshold.
